title: Toggle Link Chain
ingredient: fresh yellow genda marigolds on a cotton thread, loose petals
rhyme: the chain is a garland you wear: marigold gold = 18k gold tone
notes: Clasp exact (spring-gate ring with gate and push-pin, pave bar threaded through), ring to link 1.4 (true 1.36). Loose petals read as smooth single petals rather than ruffled marigold florets in every attempt; 01b is the most natural. Calm plaster on the left for the feed line.

title: Baguette Tennis Necklace
ingredient: Agra petha: translucent sugar-crusted rectangles on an old brass plate
rhyme: icy clear crosswise baguettes = the translucent glint of petha blocks
notes: Construction exact at full size: crosswise baguettes in gold box settings with side windows and four claws, box clasp with tongue. Petha reads true (translucent, sugar crust). Calm plaster upper left.

title: Prism Rivière Bracelet
ingredient: sugared almonds in aqua, pink and butter yellow, in an old silver katori
rhyme: the three pastel stones = the three pastel dragées of an Indian wedding favour
notes: Cushion stones in double pave halos with bead claws and gallery windows, fold-over clasp; no two neighbours share a colour. Variant b turned the plaster into travertine and crowded the frame.

title: Woven Gold Hoops
ingredient: three ripe golden wheat ears, loose grains and a bristle
rhyme: the braid of the hoops = the plaited chevron rows of a wheat ear, same warm gold
notes: Braid exact (interlaced polished strands), flat disc inside the top under the hinged latch; hoops a third of a wheat ear, true scale. Calm plaster left.

title: Verdant Eternity Band
ingredient: freshly shelled hara chana in an old brass katori, a papery pod
rhyme: oval emerald stones = plump green chickpeas, same fresh green and shape
notes: Ring exact: emerald ovals in 4 claws, the S-wave of pave weaving between them, open back with looped tips. Chickpeas about 8mm, true scale. Variant b drew the chickpeas olive-size.

title: Cushion Halo Ring
ingredient: kaju katli with silver varq, a stack on crinkled butter paper and one loose diamond, torn varq flakes
rhyme: silver varq = rhodium silver tone; the katli diamond = the cushion halo turned 45 degrees
notes: Halo exact in 06b: one row of small stones with bead claws round a 4-claw round centre, pave shoulders, plain polished shank, cool silver. 06a drew a denser double-looking halo. Ring about 1.2x against a standard katli, reads true. Feed crop starts higher (200px) so the katli stack is whole.

title: Baguette Tennis Bracelet
ingredient: a soft mound of raw long-grain basmati rice with a trail of single grains spilling into the bracelet
rhyme: slim translucent rice grains = slim icy crosswise baguettes, same size and shape
notes: Construction exact: emerald-cut baguettes crosswise in gold box settings with 4 claws, box clasp with fold-over safety. Grain to baguette width 0.6 (true 0.6), length 1.4 (true 1.15): honest scale. 07b calmer but the rice barely meets the bracelet.

title: Baguette Huggies
ingredient: a loose heap of pistachio pieces with rose-purple skins, a few loose slivers in front
rhyme: green pistachio = emerald baguettes; slim slivers = slim crosswise stones; pista is the garnish of every mithai
notes: Low 20-degree camera for variety. Construction exact: 7 crosswise emerald-cut baguettes with shared bar claws and bead tips on the lower front, hinge and snap bar visible, plain polished upper half. Pistachio reads real but pinker than the stones, so the colour rhyme is softer than the earlier plates. 08b turned the standing huggie edge-on into a column of stones.

title: Bold Nocturne Chain
ingredient: broken chunks of golden Kolhapuri jaggery (gur) with crumbs
rhyme: honey-gold gur = warm polished gold; chunky blocks = chunky links; gur, good
notes: Links exact: elongated rounded rectangles with flattened sides, each threaded through the next, one pave link the same size. Gur reads real (crystalline, sugary bloom), large but plausible at about 2.5 links. 09a wedged the chain end between the gur chunks. First cool ground of the set.

title: Bold Nocturne Bracelet
ingredient: a soft cone of haldi powder and two fresh turmeric roots, one snapped to its orange core
rhyme: haldi yellow = 18k gold tone; wedding season, the haldi ceremony
notes: 10a had the best layout but two four-point star glints on the pave link and frosted link interiors; 10b frosted too. Reshot with both faults named: 10c is clean, links polished inside and out, one pave link, lobster clasp and extender tag exact. Links match a turmeric finger in thickness.

title: Halo Curve Ring
ingredient: almonds, some with their brown skins and some soaked and peeled, one slipped skin; one brown and one peeled almond at the ring
rhyme: tiger eye = the striated brown almond skin; champagne crystal = the peeled almond; the Indian morning badam
notes: Ring exact: thin open bypass wire, banded tiger eye and faceted champagne crystal in unmatched slim bezels; each stone about half an almond, true scale. The brown almond lies under the tiger eye and the peeled one under the crystal, mirroring the pair. 11a crowded the top with the heap.
